name: First to Bachalpsee
why: An easy alpine path from the First gondola to a lake that mirrors the Schreckhorn, Wetterhorn and Eiger.
dangers: Afternoon thunderstorms in summer: be off the high paths by 14:00.

points.name: First
points.note: The gondola top station and cliff walk.

points.name: Bachalpsee
points.note: A clear lake with glaciated peaks behind.
